summary: Reserve the person Pins arrangement identity for ordered version-2 memberships

replay.detail: Existing arrangement and membership claims are unchanged.

schema.detail: A generated identity constant is added; no wire shape changes.

rules.detail: Existing membership and lifecycle rules apply.

compatibility.detail: Upgrade all owner arrangement readers to version-2-aware decoders before creating Pins, as required by the existing arrangement-v2 rollout contract. This constant creates no arrangements.

downtime.detail: No daemon rollout is required for the constant.

manual.detail: No Pins arrangement is created automatically.

recovery.detail: Reverting the constant does not remove retained memberships.
